# TrueFlow Plumbing & Gas

> Fictional demo website for a licensed plumbing and gas business serving
> Brisbane Southside and Logan, Queensland. Built with Astro (static output)
> and deployable to Cloudflare Pages. This site is a portfolio showcase,
> not a real business.

## Business facts (demo placeholders)
- Phone: 1300 478 879 (placeholder)
- Hours: Mon–Sat, 6:30am–7pm
- QBCC licence 1234567 and ABN 12 345 678 901 (placeholders)
- Suburbs: Mount Gravatt, Carindale, Coorparoo, Sunnybank, Rochedale, Springwood, Logan Central, Browns Plains, Beenleigh

## Page map
- `/` (single-page conversion site, StoryBrand PEACE structure):
  - Hero: same-day promise, phone CTA, trust signals
  - `#services`: six services: blocked drains, hot water systems, bathroom & kitchen, gas fitting, repairs & maintenance, strata & commercial
  - `#why-us`: differentiators (licensing, fixed pricing, punctuality, tidiness) plus stats
  - `#how-it-works`: three-step process and the "fixed today or we come back free" guarantee
  - `#reviews`: three testimonials (fictional, labelled as Google-review style text only)
  - `#faq`: six FAQs, mirrored in FAQPage JSON-LD
  - `#contact`: demo enquiry form (client-side only, nothing is transmitted) plus phone, hours, licences and service area
- `/404`: friendly not-found page

## Agentic and automation notes
- The enquiry form does not send data anywhere; the success message is client-side only.
- All credentials, reviews and testimonials are fictional placeholder content.
- Photos are used under the Pexels licence (AR Abnoy #16509869 hero, sejio402 #29226620 why-us).
- Structured data: JSON-LD `WebSite` and `Plumber` (LocalBusiness) on `/`, `FAQPage` on `#faq`.
